snippet.title: Wolfman Trailer
snippet.description:
WOLFMAN on Steam URL:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3185780/WOLFMAN/

WOLFMAN:
You are a wolfman hunter on a critical mission: to uncover the truth and prove that the werewolf is not just a legend, but a real and deadly threat. Your journey will bring you face to face with the beast, as you seek to end the nightmare once and for all.

WOLFMAN, is a survival horror game about hunting a wolfman. You can play against a wolfman controlled by AI.

Contact : support@lithium-studios.com
